jobs.title: Ocean Product Manager
jobs.location: Rio de janeiro, RIO DE JANEIRO, br
jobs.description:
- Business Development - Develop and execute the Ocean Product business plan aligned with district and regional growth objectives.
- Lead business development, retention, and strategic account growth initiatives in partnership with Sales and Account Management.
- Identify and develop new revenue opportunities within existing customers and the local market.
- Maintain executive relationships with key customers and actively participate in strategic customer reviews and sales calls.
- Lead the district Ocean commercial strategy, including RFQs, pricing, bids, and contract opportunities.
- Build and maintain strategic partnerships with carriers and service providers to enhance competitiveness and service offerings.
- Support new business transitions and act as the Ocean Product subject matter expert for customers and the sales organization.
- Provide market intelligence and product leadership to drive customer retention, market share growth, and revenue expansion.

- Team Management & Leadership - Build and maintain an effective organizational structure that supports growth, succession planning, and accountability.
- Develop a strong Team Leader ("#2") capable of independently managing daily Ocean Import and Export operations.
- Recruit, onboard, coach, and retain high-performing employees while promoting a strong employee experience.
- Conduct performance reviews, one-on-ones, goal-setting discussions, and career development planning.
- Create development plans and ensure employees receive the training required for future growth and succession.
- Lead change management, productivity initiatives, and continuous improvement programs across the department.
- Foster a culture of accountability, compliance, collaboration, and alignment with Expeditors' cultural values.
- Provide leadership, guidance, and escalation support while delegating daily operational execution to the Team Leader.

- Financial Management - Develop and manage the annual departmental budget in alignment with district financial objectives.
- Own the department P&L and deliver revenue growth, profitability, productivity, and expense-control targets.
- Conduct regular financial reviews and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps.
- Analyze customer, trade lane, and service profitability to support strategic commercial decisions.
- Ensure effective management of accounts receivable, credit risk, cash flow, and customer payment performance.
- Oversee financial governance, including billing integrity, intercompany accounting, contracts, and compliance with company policies.
- Monitor key financial indicators and drive actions that improve freight yields, productivity, and operating margins.
- Protect and grow the long-term financial health of the Ocean Product by balancing revenue growth, customer diversification, and cost management.
- College/University or equivalent business qualifications

- Minimum 5 years Expeditors’ or industry experience

- Strong planning and organizing skills

- Conflict resolution

- Listening skills

- Providing feedback

- Teamwork

- Building team environment

- Coaching for development

- Customer focus

- Managing meetings

- Problem solving

- Process improvement

- Time management

- Software proficiency skills (e.g., MS Excel Formulas and Pivot Tables, MS Word)

- English language proficiency

- Global Logistics Industry knowledge
Expeditors offers excellent benefits:
- Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
- Health Plan: Medical
- Life Insurance
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan
- Training and Personnel Development Program
- Growth opportunities within the company
- Employee Referral Program Bonus
